description: One coin by address: metadata, price, market cap, 24h stats, pool key, fair launch state, and `badges` (milestones reached: original, volume, holders, burner, sellout, launchRush, veteran, genesis, allStar, each with its tier, rarity and the block it was earned). For a v3 coin, `v3` names its pair token (gold, XAUm, first) and its buy, sell, large-trade and anti-snipe fees.
name: get_coin
